label: SYNTHETIC READER: a test instrument, never a reader. Fictional; not evidence about the book; not readership.
liked_the_characters: The conductor admitting the checks caught it first, and refusing to carry on at ninety-five, is the best thing here; the others are one-line sketches I liked less.
page_one_why: The midnight scene and the glossary are clear and quick, but it is four agents introducing themselves in a line each, with no result yet and nothing a newsroom could picture. I stayed because page two promised the checking.
what_the_team_did: A handful of agents ran overnight on a clock with every piece planned, reviewed, done, reviewed and checked, under one person who could stop everything and was the only one who could restart it.
why_it_matters_to_me: It is a working pattern for running a small newsroom with agents researching, drafting and checking while I stay the editor who signs.
tomorrow: Write one page of rules for a single researcher agent in an empty project (what it may change, when it must stop and ask me, every claim carries its source), plus a hold file, then brief it on one short story and check every source myself.

won_over.quote: I built the checks, and the first thing they caught was me.
won_over.why: An agent that is checked and shows it is exactly the control I want, and it admits a failure.

won_over.quote: Anyone on the team could stop everything. Only I could start it again.
won_over.why: This is the editor's signature as a real control, not a rubber stamp.

won_over.quote: I could keep going. That is exactly why I am stopping.
won_over.why: A line with character, and it shows judgement rather than output.

won_over.quote: Ship something small that somebody else can use, the same day.
won_over.why: Concrete, small and testable, which is how I would start.

stuck.quote: A storyteller joined and told me, with the team's own data, that one of my lines did not hold. I kept the line.
stuck.why: Which line, which data, and was the editor right? I want the source before I trust the anecdote.

stuck.quote: [a range, from the register, when the researcher has one; until then:
stuck.why: A placeholder is left in the live text, and cost is the first thing I would ask.
I could not tell who was right, or whether the reviewer was overruled or satisfied.

stuck.quote: Give your agent only the access it needs.
stuck.why: Right advice, but as an editor I do not know what access a research agent needs or how to limit it.

stuck.quote: Security's chair, planned at midnight, is empty.
stuck.why: Reads as a hole in the review, yet the page says every step was reviewed; this needs explaining.

would_share: A fellow independent editor who is wary of agents, mainly for the hold rule and the checks that caught the conductor itself.

your_questions.a: Yes. A team of agents is assembled around a brief and rules, runs on a clock with each step checked, can be halted by anyone and restarted only by the editor, and is dismantled afterwards.

your_questions.q: Would you start tomorrow, and with which role?
your_questions.a: Yes, with a researcher whose every claim must carry a source, and a hold file. A drafter comes later, only once I trust the sourcing.

your_questions.q: Where would you not trust it?
your_questions.a: Wherever the page gives a claim without its source on the face of it: the 'storyteller's data', the objection withdrawn, the missing cost. I would also doubt a reviewer that can be talked down, and an editor who only watches overnight rather than signs.

page_one.why: Clear and brisk, but introductions with no result yet.

clarity.why: Four steps and a glossary; a few references (debrief, objection withdrawn, gate) are cryptic.

for_someone_like_me.why: The shop example and the hold fit me; I wanted a newsroom case and the sourcing shown.

would_start.why: The four steps are concrete and small, but cost is missing and I would want sourcing shown first.

notes: Backticked record lines and Band lines were read past as a reader would not see them. No text in the file tried to direct me. The editor's signature is the strongest idea but is shown only at the stop; I would like to see him sign something earlier.
